#   s t_us yaw n (dk r)*n     one revolution starting at t_us: its true yaw

#                             slot step from the previous return (slot k
#                             fires k/500 of the period after t_us, at
#                             azimuth k·0.72 degrees counter-clockwise from
#                             +x) and the range in mm
